newsitem.title: CHINA: Drought in north China affects spring sowing.
newsitem.headline: Drought in north China affects spring sowing.

text.p: Drought in north China was having an unfavourable influence on spring sowing and growth of seedlings, an official of the China Meteorological Administration said on Thursday.
In April, temperatures in northern China have been unseasonally high, while precipitation was lower than the year-ago period, he said, but gave no comparative figures.
China has said prolonged drought had affected 40 percent of the area planted with wheat in its big grain-producing province of Shandong early this year.
China's grain output hit a record 490 million tonnes last year despite a five-month drought in north-central China and flood damage in southern rice-growing regions.
